sad.title: Sadness over limit
sad.description: Your sadness reached its limit. You lose life points equal to your constitution, your sadness resets to zero and you are forced to sleep.

coma.title: You're in a coma
coma.description:
Your life reached zero.

You cannot act and you cannot move until another character rescues you or you get sleeping in a safe location.

When all players in a game are in a coma, a special event occurs: could be Game over.

allComa.title: Everyone has fallen
allComa.description: Every character is in a coma. Nobody can act any more. When all players have zero health, they fall into a coma. When all players in a game are in a coma, a special event occurs: could be Game over.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Paths Games ('we', 'us') collects and processes personal data when you use the game, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA). Paths Games is designed to need as little personal data as possible: you play anonymously, with no registration, name or email required.
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller is Paths Games. We aim to comply with applicable EU and US data-protection law. For any privacy request or question, contact us at paths.games@proton.me.
privacy.dataBody: We do not ask for your name, email or payment details. We process an anonymous guest identifier (a random UUID and an auto-generated username), session and refresh tokens that keep you signed in, your in-game progress linked to that anonymous identifier, and — only if you consent — anonymous usage statistics via Google Analytics. Our hosting and content-delivery providers also process technical data such as your IP address and device or browser type transiently to deliver and secure the service.
privacy.purposesTitle: 3. Why we process it and the legal basis
privacy.purposesBody: We process strictly necessary data to provide the game you request (performance of a contract and our legitimate interest in running the service), to keep it secure and prevent abuse (legitimate interest), and to measure usage through analytics (your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw analytics consent at any time.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use strictly necessary cookies and, with your consent, analytics cookies. Full details, including names and durations, are in our Cookies Policy, which you can reopen at any time via 'Cookie settings'.
privacy.sharingBody: We use Google (Google Analytics and Tag Manager) for optional analytics and Amazon Web Services / CloudFront for hosting and content delivery; they act as our processors. We do not sell or 'share' your personal information as those terms are defined under the CCPA/CPRA, and we do not use it for cross-context behavioural advertising.
privacy.transfersBody: Some providers (such as Google) may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Such transfers are protected by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent safeguard.
privacy.retentionBody: Session cookies last up to 7 days (refresh token) and 30 days (guest identifier); your cookie choice is kept for 6 months; analytics data is retained for up to 2 years. Anonymous guest data is removed after prolonged inactivity.
privacy.rightsBody: If you are in the EU/EEA you may access, rectify, erase, restrict or port your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time, and you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. If you are a California resident you have the right to know, delete and correct your data and to opt out of sale or sharing (we do not sell or share), free from discrimination for exercising your rights. Because play is anonymous, we may be unable to identify your data without additional information from you.
privacy.childrenBody: Paths Games is not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us data, contact us at paths.games@proton.me and we will delete it.
privacy.securityBody: We use measures such as HTTPS/TLS, HttpOnly session cookies and access controls to protect data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and the game is currently in an alpha development phase.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as the game evolves; material changes will be reflected by the 'last updated' date below and, where required, by a renewed consent request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your use of the Paths Games game and website. By accessing or playing Paths Games you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.acceptanceBody: You must be at least 16 years old to use Paths Games. By using the service you confirm that you meet this requirement and accept these Terms together with our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy.
terms.serviceBody: Paths Games is a free-to-play gamebook video game with branching, multiplayer stories. It is currently in an alpha development phase and is provided 'as is' and 'as available'; features may change, break or be removed at any time.
terms.guestBody: Play is anonymous through an automatically created guest session; no registration is required. You are responsible for activity carried out through your session on your device. We may reset or revoke sessions to protect the service.
terms.useBody: You agree not to misuse the service, including by cheating or manipulating game state, attempting unauthorised access, scraping or automated data collection, reverse-engineering beyond what the software licence permits, disrupting the service, or using it for any unlawful purpose.
terms.ipBody: The Paths Games source code is open source under the GNU GPL v3.0. The narrative content and assets — stories, dialogues, characters, artwork, sound and music — are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) and remain the property of their authors. You may not use them beyond what those licences allow.
terms.disclaimerBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and availability. As an alpha product it may contain bugs, lose progress or experience downtime.
terms.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Paths Games Team is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages, or loss of data or game progress, arising from your use of the service. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot be limited under the mandatory consumer-protection law of your country or state of residence.
terms.availabilityBody: We may modify, suspend or discontinue all or part of the service at any time, and may suspend access for users who breach these Terms. Because the game is in development, availability is not guaranteed.
terms.thirdPartyBody: The service links to or relies on third parties such as GitHub and Google; their own terms and privacy policies apply to your use of them.
terms.privacyRefBody: Your use of Paths Games is also governed by our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy, which explain how we handle data and cookies.
terms.lawBody: These Terms are governed by applicable European Union and United States law. Where you are a consumer, you also benefit from any mandatory protections of the law of your country or state of residence, which these Terms do not override.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms as the game evolves; the 'last updated' date below indicates the latest version. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookies Policy explains how Paths Games uses cookies and similar technologies in this game. A cookie is a small text file stored on your device. We group cookies into the categories below; you can accept or reject non-essential cookies at any time.
cookies.necessaryBody: These keep your anonymous guest session active and remember your cookie choice. They are essential, so they are always on and do not require consent: pathsgames.guestcookie (30 days), pathsgames.refreshToken (7 days) and pathsgames.cookiesConsent (6 months).
cookies.analyticsBody: With your consent we use Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_*, up to 2 years) to measure usage anonymously and improve the game. Thanks to Google Consent Mode v2 these stay disabled until you accept, and no analytics cookie is written before then.
cookies.legalBody: We rely on the technical necessity of providing the service for strictly necessary cookies (exempt from consent under the ePrivacy Directive), and on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for analytics cookies.
cookies.manageBody: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the "Cookie settings" button below, with the same ease as giving it. You can also delete or block cookies through your browser settings, though strictly necessary cookies are required for the game to function.
cookies.thirdPartyBody: Analytics cookies are provided by Google. Google may process data outside the European Economic Area; such transfers are covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses. We do not sell your personal data.
cookies.rightsBody: Under the GDPR you may access, rectify or erase your data, object to or restrict processing, request portability, and withdraw consent at any time. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. For requests, contact us at paths.games@proton.me.
